mapper.select: SELECT ASSIGNEE_USER, DATE_FLAG, All_DATE_FLAG, ASS_ID, PROC_ID, PROC_INST_ID, ACT_ID, ACT_NAME, MODIFY_DATE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS newDate, OVER_INTO_TIME, EXPIRE_INTO_TIME, START_USER, OVER_TIME, EXPIRE_TIME, operation_type_id, operation_type_name, OVER_TIME_NOTIFY_WAY, EXPIRE_TIME_NOTIFY_WAY, PROC_TITLE, START_TIME, CASE WHEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP > OVER_INTO_TIME THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS OVER_DATE_FLAG_1, CASE WHEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP > EXPIRE_INTO_TIME THEN CASE WHEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP > OVER_INTO_TIME THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ELSE 0 END AS EXPIRE_DATE_FLAG_1 FROM ( SELECT fg.ASSIGNEE_USER, fg.DATE_FLAG, fg.All_DATE_FLAG, fg.ID AS ASS_ID, aa.PROC_ID, aa.PROC_INST_ID, aa.ACT_ID, aa.ACT_NAME, aa.MODIFY_DATE, CASE WHEN bb.ASS_TYPE = '1' THEN DATEADD(MINUTE, bb.OVER_TIME, aa.MODIFY_DATE) WHEN bb.ASS_TYPE = '2' THEN ( SELECT TOP 1 DATES FROM ipm_sys_calender WHERE WORK_MARKERS = 'y' AND DATES > CAST(aa.MODIFY_DATE AS DATE) ORDER BY DATES ASC ) ELSE NULL END AS OVER_INTO_TIME, CASE WHEN bb.ASS_TYPE = '1' THEN CASE WHEN bb.EXPIRE_TIME = 0 THEN NULL ELSE DATEADD(MINUTE, bb.EXPIRE_TIME, aa.MODIFY_DATE) END WHEN bb.ASS_TYPE = '2' THEN ( SELECT TOP 1 DATES FROM ipm_sys_calender WHERE WORK_MARKERS = 'y' AND DATES > CAST(aa.MODIFY_DATE AS DATE) ORDER BY DATES ASC ) ELSE NULL END AS EXPIRE_INTO_TIME, aa.START_USER, aa.PROC_TITLE, aa.START_TIME, bb.OVER_TIME, bb.EXPIRE_TIME, bb.OVER_TIME_NOTIFY_WAY, bb.EXPIRE_TIME_NOTIFY_WAY, cc.operation_type_id, cc.operation_type_name FROM ( SELECT PROCESS_INFO_ID, PROC_INST_ID, PROC_ID, ACT_ID, ACT_NAME, START_USER, MODIFY_DATE， PROC_TITLE, START_TIME FROM cud_wb_process_info_t WHERE FLOW_STATUS != 99 AND DELETE_FLAG = '1' ) aa LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ACT_ID, OVER_TIME, EXPIRE_TIME, OVER_TIME_NOTIFY_WAY, EXPIRE_TIME_NOTIFY_WAY, ASS_TYPE FROM cud_wf_activity_def_t WHERE OVER_TIME > 0 OR EXPIRE_TIME > 0 ) bb ON aa.ACT_ID = bb.ACT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT l1.proc_inst_id, l1.CREATE_DATE, l1.operation_type_id, l1.operation_type_name FROM ( SELECT proc_inst_id, CREATE_DATE, operation_type_id, operation_type_name FROM cud_log_procinstoperation WHERE operation_type_id NOT IN ('0', '1', '2') ) l1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT proc_inst_id, MAX(CREATE_DATE) AS CREATE_DATE FROM cud_log_procinstoperation GROUP BY proc_inst_id ) l2 ON l1.proc_inst_id = l2.proc_inst_id AND l1.CREATE_DATE = l2.CREATE_DATE ) cc ON aa.proc_inst_id = cc.proc_inst_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ass.ID, ass.PROCESS_INFO_ID, ass.ACT_ID, ass.ASSIGNEE_USER, ass.CASSIGNEE_FLAG, ass.DATE_FLAG, pr.DATE_FLAG AS All_DATE_FLAG FROM ( SELECT ID, PROCESS_INFO_ID, ACT_ID, ASSIGNEE_USER, CASSIGNEE_FLAG, DATE_FLAG FROM ipm_process_assignee ) ass LEFT JOIN ipm_process_statue pr ON pr.PROCESS_INFO_ID = ass.PROCESS_INFO_ID ) fg ON aa.PROC_INST_ID = fg.PROCESS_INFO_ID AND aa.ACT_ID = fg.ACT_ID WHERE ASSIGNEE_USER IS NOT NULL ) cs WHERE OVER_TIME IS NOT NULL OR EXPIRE_TIME IS NOT NULL
